question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
-- Calculate percentage of customers who have rented films featuring top 5 actors
WITH top5_actors AS (
    SELECT a.actor_id
    FROM actor a
    JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
    GROUP BY a.actor_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(fa.film_id) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
customers_with_top5 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.customer_id
    FROM rental r
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id
    WHERE fa.actor_id IN (SELECT actor_id FROM top5_actors)
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(1.0 * COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer), 2) AS percentage
FROM customers_with_top5;
